questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring architectural and interior design. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to architectural and interior design, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with architectural and interior design. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with architectural and interior design. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Design a small space (e.g. a pavilion, studio or room) for a specific site and purpose. Show plans, elevations, a scale model and a written rationale explaining how your design responds to its context. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: produce accurate scale drawings; build a refined architectural model; explain how the design responds to site and context; consider lighting, materials and atmosphere; annotate with specialist vocabulary (plan, elevation, section, spatial flow); evaluate the design's effectiveness. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
